script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for February 7. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Feel the wind on your face.  You're experiencing the Sun's energy in motion.  Sunlight heats the ground unevenly—deserts get hotter than forests, land heats faster than ocean.

High pressure air contains more molecules packed together; low pressure has fewer. Nature hates imbalance, so air flows from high to low pressure. The bigger the difference, the faster the wind. Hurricanes form around extreme low-pressure centers. Earth's rotation curves wind paths.  In the Northern Hemisphere, wind curves right; in the Southern, left.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Imbalance creates movement.  When things are perfectly balanced, nothing happens.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Imbalance Audit - Pressure Differences.

Here's your activity: Identify one 'pressure difference' in your life—a gap between where you are and where you want to be. This tension isn't bad; it's what creates movement. Acknowledge it as energy waiting to flow. This helps you identify productive tensions that create movement in your life.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about what makes wind blow can be applied to imbalance audit - pressure differences. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
